text:
ana_ml: Hey, starting onboarding for Loomis-7B-Lite (https://huggingface.co/loomis/7b-lite). License header says `Research-Only v1.1` + attribution addendum: \"no commercial use, no redistribution, must include model id+url on downstream apps\". Planning to: run quantization experiments (8-bit/4-bit), serve embeddings via Dedicated, and possibly offer a customer-facing feature using hosted inference. Quick triage: (1) can we quantize for internal evals? (2) can we serve embeddings/completions to customers (commercial) on Redwood Hosted/Dedicated? (3) is serving from our API considered redistribution if we don't hand out files? Need legal callouts before Evals start.

jamal_legal: Thanks — quick notes from reading the snippet you pasted. \"No commercial use\" generally prohibits using model to provide paid services or to internal features that drive revenue. Serving embeddings / completions to customers is likely commercial. Two important distinctions: 1) \"redistribution\" = distributing model weights (or derivative checkpoint files) to third parties; 2) \"hosting/serving\" is often treated separately — some licenses allow hosting but not redistribution. We need the exact license text. Please attach the full LICENSE file.

maria_eng: fwiw, from an infra POV: we can do quantization for evals locally (ana, go ahead). Shipping quantized weights to customers is trivial technically, but that'd be redistribution. Alternative: run quantized model inside Dedicated pools and never give out .pt files. That might satisfy \"no redistribution\" but not \"no commercial use\".

tom_infra: Also check whether the customer contract allows them to bring their own model. If we host for them in a Dedicated instance under their contract, is that still \"our\" commercial use? jamal?

jamal_legal: Hosting a model for a customer to use a paid product is still commercial use by Redwood (or by the customer depending on contract). If license forbids commercial use, we cannot offer it as part of a paid service unless we negotiate a commercial license. Regarding caches/KV: transient runtime caches (KV cache) are not redistribution, but persistent storage of weights or providing checkpoint downloads is.

license-check-bot: quick-scan: found phrase \"No commercial use\" (section 2), \"No redistribution of model weights\" (section 4), \"Mandatory attribution: include model id + url\" (section 7). No explicit exception for embeddings. Flags: commercial-hosting, redistribution, attribution UI requirement.

ana_ml: Thanks. Plan: (A) run quant/eval in-house and report metrics (perplexity, embeddings stability) — no weight export. (B) open a legal ticket to request a commercial license or explicit hosting exception. (C) if legal says no, we'll only use Loomis in internal research sandboxes and not in production. I'll post the LICENSE file in the ticket.

maria_eng: For the evals, quick commands I'll run:
```
git clone https://hf.co/loomis/7b-lite
python quantize.py --model loomis-7b --bits 8 --out loomis-7b-q8.pt
python eval.py --model loomis-7b-q8.pt --evalsets wikitext,bench
```
We'll avoid storing `loomis-7b-q8.pt` in any shared artifacts bucket; ephemeral CI only.

jamal_legal: Good. One more ask: if we plan to surface attribution in-app, capture the exact wording they require and store it in the legal ticket. If they require hyperlink plus model id visible to end-users, that may affect UI/UX for embeddings endpoints.

ana_ml: Quick results from a local run (internal): quant 8-bit -> +0.9% ppl vs fp16, latency down ~28%. Embedding cosine sims stable within 1.5%. Not sending weights out. Will attach binary eval artifacts to the legal ticket (metrics only).

tom_infra: I'll create a Dedicated config option that marks model as \"licensed-only\" so we can gate deploys if/when legal approves commercial hosting.

maria_eng: :thumbsup: Keep us posted.

ana_ml: Filing ticket now and attaching LICENSE + eval summary. Thanks all.
